notes: Followed the plumbeer-place-finder skill end-to-end (Step 0 inputs, Step 1 dependency check, Step 2 STAR plan, Step 3 execution, Step 4/5 Results+Missing tables), treating every checkpoint as approved since there was no human to check in with, per this eval's instructions. Biggest tool limitation: direct Instagram profile fetches were blocked (HTTP 429) in Step 1's dependency check, so the whole run used the skill's documented search-snippet fallback for Instagram — handles and follower counts came from web-search snippets/titles, not live profile views. Consequences: follower counts are rounded/approximate; Instagram bios could not be checked directly for wa.me links, so WhatsApp numbers came from each org's own website/contact page instead; one snippet gave an implausible follower count for RoboFEI (reported as unverified rather than trusted); two SBC-unit-specific Instagram accounts (Happy Code, CódigoKid) could not be located at all, only a brand-level account or none. No geocoding tool existed to compute true straight-line distances, so the 5km radius was applied qualitatively by neighborhood (one candidate, RoboFEI/FEI in Bairro Assunção, is flagged as the least certain fit). All 10 Results entries are real, verifiable organizations with a confirmed São Bernardo do Campo address or explicit SBC affiliation; no data was fabricated — every blank field is reported as 'Not found' rather than guessed, and 4 weaker/unverifiable candidates were routed to the Missing table with reasons instead of being force-fit into the top 10.
